comments.name: Monz
comments.text: The #10 Nicanor piece is definitely my fave! Yes I am biased cuz buff scalie, but the tremendous effort really shows! I was pleasantly surprised at how distinct each piece felt. Really flexing that artist muscle~

comments.name: Briva
comments.text: You did so much this year despite how busy it all was! Very impressed with all of these, but I think I'm going to have to give it to #2 - Rieger as my favorite (excluding your attack on me, of course :3c). I love the softer highlights and shadows along with a very relaxed pose showing off the amazing anatomy work! I get a very cozy vibe from it, like it's a panel pulled straight from a "slice of life" style illustration.

comments.name: Regal
comments.text: That's very high praise, thank you! I tried pretty hard to get that to look kinda like a "Men's Fitness" type of pinup. Glad it worked out! :3
